verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 4.138
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 4.138

verses.pali: 14. Puggalavagga
verses.english: 14. Individuals

verses.pali: Nikaṭṭhasutta
verses.english: Retreat

verses.pali: “Cattārome, bhikkhave, puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmiṁ.
verses.english: “Mendicants, these four individuals are found in the world.

verses.pali: Katame cattāro?
verses.english: What four?

verses.pali: Nikaṭṭhakāyo anikaṭṭhacitto,
verses.english: One is on retreat in body, but not mind;

verses.pali: anikaṭṭhakāyo nikaṭṭhacitto,
verses.english: one is on retreat in mind, but not body;

verses.pali: anikaṭṭhakāyo ca anikaṭṭhacitto ca,
verses.english: one is on retreat in neither body nor mind; and

verses.pali: nikaṭṭhakāyo ca nikaṭṭhacitto ca.
verses.english: one is on retreat in both body and mind.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo nikaṭṭhakāyo hoti anikaṭṭhacitto?
verses.english: And how is an individual on retreat in body, but not mind?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevati.
verses.english: It’s when an individual frequents remote lodgings in the wilderness and the forest.

verses.pali: So tattha kāmavitakkampi vitakketi byāpādavitakkampi vitakketi vihiṁsāvitakkampi vitakketi.
verses.english: But they think sensual, malicious, and cruel thoughts.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo nikaṭṭhakāyo hoti anikaṭṭhacitto.
verses.english: That’s how an individual is on retreat in body, but not mind.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo anikaṭṭhakāyo hoti nikaṭṭhacitto?
verses.english: And how is an individual on retreat in mind, but not body?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo naheva kho araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevati.
verses.english: It’s when an individual doesn’t frequent remote lodgings in the wilderness and the forest.

verses.pali: So tattha nekkhammavitakkampi vitakketi abyāpādavitakkampi vitakketi avihiṁsāvitakkampi vitakketi.
verses.english: But they think thoughts of renunciation, good will, and harmlessness.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo anikaṭṭhakāyo hoti nikaṭṭhacitto.
verses.english: That’s how an individual is on retreat in mind, but not body.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo anikaṭṭhakāyo ca hoti anikaṭṭhacitto ca?
verses.english: And how is an individual on retreat in neither body nor mind?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo naheva kho araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevati.
verses.english: It’s when an individual doesn’t frequent remote lodgings in the wilderness and the forest.

verses.pali: So tattha kāmavitakkampi vitakketi byāpādavitakkampi vitakketi vihiṁsāvitakkampi vitakketi.
verses.english: And they think sensual, malicious, and cruel thoughts.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo anikaṭṭhakāyo ca hoti anikaṭṭhacitto ca.
verses.english: That’s how an individual is on retreat in neither body nor mind.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo nikaṭṭhakāyo ca hoti nikaṭṭhacitto ca?
verses.english: And how is an individual on retreat in both body and mind?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevati.
verses.english: It’s when an individual frequents remote lodgings in the wilderness and the forest.

verses.pali: So tattha nekkhammavitakkampi vitakketi abyāpādavitakkampi vitakketi avihiṁsāvitakkampi vitakketi.
verses.english: And they think thoughts of renunciation, good will, and harmlessness.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo nikaṭṭhakāyo ca hoti nikaṭṭhacitto ca.
verses.english: That’s how an individual is on retreat in both body and mind.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmin”ti.
verses.english: These are the four individuals found in the world.”

verses.pali: Aṭṭhamaṁ.
